notes.text: - N-S corridor north to south: **Srinagar – Agra – Gwalior – Jhansi – Nagpur – Hyderabad – Bengaluru – Krishnagiri – Kanyakumari** (NH-44, so it **passes through Hyderabad**).

exam: APPSC AEE Mains General Studies & Mental Ability 2016
q: Name the state in which the first Green Rail Corridor was launched in India
explanation: India's first Green Rail Corridor (2016, toilet-discharge-free) was the Rameswaram–Manamadurai section in Tamil Nadu.

q: The Integral Coach Factory at Perambur designed and assembled bogies for the Konkan Railway Corporation's unique new-concept train called:
explanation: ICF Perambur built the bogies for Konkan Railway Corporation's elevated 'Sky Bus' system.
